consequence.statement: In the external-secrets.io/v1beta1 schema, a ClusterSecretStore whose spec.provider.fake.data[] entries leave out `value` fails schema validation and is rejected.
consequence.remediation: Give every spec.provider.fake.data[] entry in v1beta1 ClusterSecretStore manifests a `value` before applying them against the new CRDs.

assertion.statement: From 0.15.0 to 0.16.0, the external-secrets.io/v1beta1 ClusterSecretStore schema starts requiring `value` on every spec.provider.fake.data[] entry, alongside `key`, so objects that leave it out are rejected.
